page.overview:
Who is Brushfire?

Brushfire is a new Rescue Bot recruit who changes into a half-track vehicle. He safeguards the forests of Earth with the aid of the Mini-Con bear Sequoia.

In this series, Brushfire is depicted as a female Cybertronian who roams Australia's outback, watching over the native wildlife, while taking pride in her freedom.

When a town was threatened by unruly mobs of kangaroos, she called in the Rescue Bot recruits to help investigate. Together with Whirl, she found that some of the roos were fleeing a bushfire, and with the help of the recruits, put out the various fires. Brushfire then declined joining the academy as she was perfectly happy with being on her own. Later, Brushfire was among the Transformers the recruits have met that Whirl recruited to stop Citadel Secundus crashing into Earth; Brushfire was given the task of clearing an area of land near the Academy to provide a safe landing spot, which she successfully did before the Titan was landed. Afterwards, she was invited to join the Academy by Optimus Prime himself.
